summary: Verified Metro Motors backend lifecycle CRUD and relationship rules against the public API, plus desktop/mobile frontend navigation and interactions.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses explicit string IDs and projections excluding MongoDB _id; no critical serialization or relationship issue was found.
Frontend remains placeholder-data based and does not call the new CRUD APIs; this is consistent with the requested database-only stage, but must be addressed before a functional UI release.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all executed checks passed; mobile flow passed on focused retry)

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ vehicle, seller, buyer, deal, witness, payment, document, and bill records were created and deleted during the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend lifecycle, invalid parent/child references, deal update identity, guarded deal deletion, Mongo-safe responses, all seven routes, search, New Deal tabs, and mobile navigation were covered. No APIs were mocked.
rca of the issue: No unresolved product issue reproduced. The initial mobile assertion was transient during the first public-page reload; a focused retry confirmed sidebar class 'is-open' and navigation to Deals.
